title: Angle
description: Estimate the size of each angle and build a streak before your attempts run out.
about:
Angle is a browser game where you look at the displayed angle, enter your estimate and press Check. Try to keep a streak before your attempts run out.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Look at the displayed angle, enter your estimate and press Check. Try to keep a streak before your attempts run out.
tips: Use number field to enter an angle estimate.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Angle?
faq.answer: Look at the displayed angle, enter your estimate and press Check. Try to keep a streak before your attempts run out.

faq.question: Can I play Angle in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
